nodes.label: Local Development Setup Instructions
nodes.rationale: Documents build workflow: npm run setup, npm run build outputs to ./dist/, load unpacked from ./dist/chrome or ./dist/firefox, rebuild+reload after changes.

nodes.label: Why LeetHub Was Built (Rationale)
nodes.rationale: After the 2023 SVB bank closure and layoffs, author wanted a durable record of skill maintenance: a repo with commit history and notes. Previous/other extensions broke due to LeetCode/GitHub changes, so author rebuilt using the original LeetHub as a starting point.
